summary.intent: Execute phase 19.2 (IPFS upload performance optimization) gap closure plans, then conduct three-point local baseline comparison to validate the performance improvements from concurrent SDK pinning and pebbleds datastore changes.
summary.outcome: Gap closure plans 19.2-03 and 19.2-04 were initiated; PERF-09 was registered in REQUIREMENTS.md, the plan was updated with an accurate four-run test methodology (concurrency probe + three matched-environment baselines), and the environment was configured with someguy delegated routing and inline secret passing. Load testing had not yet started by end of transcript.

repo: IPFS stack runs on 192.168.133.114; Docker Compose manages Kubo with configurable IPFS_PROFILE (flatfs vs pebbleds). Switching to pebbleds requires volume deletion and fresh repo init.

Rate limiting is bypassed via two mechanisms: LOAD_TEST_SECRET sent to POST /auth/test-login, and THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET sent as X-Throttle-Bypass header — both checked by BypassableThrottlerGuard, only active when NODE_ENV !== 'production'.
Vitest does not load dotenv automatically — load test secrets must be passed as inline shell env vars, not set in .env files.
DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL in apps/api/.env controls IPNS routing; was pointing to localhost:3001 (mock-ipns-routing), updated to http://192.168.133.114:8190 (someguy) for staging-closer behavior.

Pre-optimization baselines were captured in a different environment and client count than post-optimization baselines, making the comparison non-definitive — matched-environment three-point testing is the fix.
REQUIREMENTS.md coverage stopped at PERF-08; PERF-09 was referenced in plans but never registered, creating a traceability gap.

code.finding: Concurrent pin orchestration implemented via Promise.allSettled to parallelize IPNS publish and folder metadata update steps that previously ran sequentially.
Collects per-operation p50/p95/p99/min/max/avg latencies plus throughput ops/s — sufficient for three-point comparison.
Runs N clients × 20 files each with file sizes 1KB-500KB; client count controlled via LOAD_TEST_CLIENTS env var.
DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL changed from http://localhost:3001 to http://192.168.133.114:8190 to use real someguy delegated routing instead of mock-ipns-routing.

workflow: When staging and local baselines use different client counts and environments, the comparison is non-definitive — always lock environment and client count across all baseline runs.
Three-point isolation testing (baseline / optimization A / optimization A+B) reveals each layer's individual contribution, which a simple before/after cannot.
Secrets needed by test harnesses that bypass framework loading (like Vitest without dotenv) must be passed as inline shell env vars: SECRET=val pnpm exec vitest run ...
Destructive staging deployments (volume deletion for pebbleds migration) can be avoided by running matched local baselines — equivalent statistical validity without production risk.

friction: Initial post-optimization baselines were captured under mismatched conditions (different environments, different client counts), requiring a full replan of 19.2-04.
Vitest does not load dotenv, so secrets cannot be set in .env — discovered mid-session, requiring test command pattern change.
PERF-09 was referenced in plans throughout but never formally registered in REQUIREMENTS.md, causing verification failure.
The pebbleds datastore switch requires IPFS volume deletion, making it destructive to staged data — adds operational friction to baseline collection.
